name: mirofish
description: MiroFish - 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.setup:local: npm ci && npm ci --prefix frontend && cd backend && uv sync --extra local --locked
scripts.backend:local: cd backend && uv run --extra local --locked python run.py
scripts.check:local: cd backend && uv run --extra local --locked python scripts/local_doctor.py --probe
scripts.test:local: cd backend && uv run --extra local --locked python scripts/run_offline_tests.py
